name: Garvin County, OK
findings: Garvin County has 45 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Garvin County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
76% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Garvin County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 82% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
